column1: G2. Is there anything else you would like to share about how digital communication has influenced your understanding of diesel emissions or air quality in your community?

Yes. I think to also better understand this, we also need to understand how capitalism and colonialism have also played a part in this. For example, a resident in Polokwane is expected to do so much to curb air pollution while big corporations in the west rarely do nothing. That’s another conversation we need to have.
There is a little if not enough information about diesel emissions. You hardly see campaigns or any ongoing information dissemination about diesel emissions or air pollution.

Yes. I maintain that a real chat needs to be had about the actual people air polluters, which are the western powers and how they evade accountability by blaming the global south and expecting them to do more in terms of fixing the problem.
Digital communications like watsaap and Facebook has helped me to learn more about diesel smoke and air pollution in my community.i now understand better than before.

Digital communication has assisted me to be more aware of how diesel emissions affect air quality and the environment. Social media and online information make it easier to learn about air pollution, share information, and understand the importance of reducing vehicle emissions in my community.

Digital communication has helped me understand diesel emissions and air quality by giving me easy access to information. Social media and online news have made me more aware of how pollution affects health and the environment in my community.
It has made me think than instead of burning rubbish, we should recycle so we stop air pollution
Use AI to inform people about pollution without using man power
It has helped me to be aware of the problem and also share with some of my community members and family members that do not have access to internet and online news
That it is not an individual’s problem we can all be affected
